title: Recover merge-queue declaration drift safely
trigger: Merge preflight finds drift between the landed gate declaration and live enforcement rules, or apply receives unlanded content.
need: Admission, Doctor and real apply fetch the declaration from the project gate branch. Land added checks before applying. Real apply refuses declaration_not_landed for differing sent content; preview may inspect lane content. Remove or rename checks in two PRs: land and apply the declaration change, then change CI jobs. Restore unreadable gate access before retrying; never apply a stale lane declaration.
